camel_example: aliyun alb CreateListener --region cn-hangzhou --ListenerPort 80 --LoadBalancerId 'alb-n5qw04uq8vavfe0000' --ListenerProtocol HTTP --DefaultActions.1.Type ForwardGroup --method POST --force
kebab_example: aliyun alb create-listener --load-balancer-id alb-n5qw04uq8vavfe0000 --listener-protocol HTTP --listener-port 80 --default-actions '[{"Type":"ForwardGroup","ForwardGroupConfig":{}}]' --region cn-hangzhou
name: CreateListener

parameters.help_en: The Application Load Balancing (ALB) instance ID
parameters.name: load_balancer_id

parameters.help_en:
The client token that is used to ensure the idempotence of the request.

You can use the client to generate the token, but you must make sure that the token is unique among different requests. The token can contain only ASCII characters.

If you do not specify this parameter, the system automatically uses the RequestId of the API request as the ClientToken. The RequestId may be different for each API request
parameters.help_zh:
客户端Token，用于保证请求的幂等性。

从您的客户端生成一个参数值，确保不同请求间该参数值唯一。ClientToken只支持ASCII字符。

若您未指定，则系统自动使用API请求的RequestId作为ClientToken标识。每次API请求的RequestId不一样
parameters.name: client_token

parameters.help_en:
Specifies whether to perform only a dry run, without performing the actual request. Valid values:

true: performs only a dry run. The system checks the request for potential issues, including missing parameter values, incorrect request syntax, and service limits. If the request fails the dry run, an error code is returned. If the request passes the dry run, the `DryRunOperation` error code is returned.

false (default): performs a dry run and performs the actual request. If the request passes the dry run, an HTTP 2xx status code is returned and the operation is performed
parameters.help_zh:
是否只预检此次请求，取值：

true：发送检查请求，不会创建监听。检查项包括是否填写了必需参数、请求格式、业务限制。如果检查不通过，则返回对应错误。如果检查通过，则返回错误码`DryRunOperation`。

false（默认值）：发送正常请求，通过检查后返回HTTP 2xx状态码并直接进行操作
parameters.name: dry_run

parameters.help_en:
The listener protocol.

Valid values: HTTP, HTTPS, and QUIC
parameters.name: listener_protocol

parameters.help_en:
The frontend port that is used by the load balancing instance.

Valid values: 1 to 65535
parameters.help_zh:
负载均衡实例前端使用的端口。

取值：1~65535
parameters.name: listener_port

parameters.help_en:
The custom listener name.

The name must be 2 to 256 characters in length, and can contain letters, digits, hyphens (-), forward slashes (/), periods (.), and underscores (_)
parameters.help_zh:
自定义监听名称。

长度为2~256个字符，必须是中文和无害字符串中的字符，可包含中文、字母、数字、短划线（-）、正斜线（/）、半角句号（.）、下划线（_）
parameters.name: listener_description

parameters.help_en:
The request timeout period. Unit: seconds.

Valid values: 1 to 600.

Default value: 60.

If no response is received from the backend server within the timeout period, load balancing sends an `HTTP 504` error code to the client.

You can submit a quota increase request to increase the request timeout period to a maximum of 3600 seconds
parameters.help_zh:
指定请求超时时间。单位：秒。

取值：1~600。

默认值：60。

如果在超时时间内后端服务器一直没有响应，负载均衡将放弃等待，并给客户端返回` HTTP 504 `错误码。

用户可以申请提升配额将请求超时时间提升至最大3600秒
parameters.name: request_timeout

parameters.help_en:
The idle connection timeout period. Unit: seconds.

Valid values: 1 to 600.

Default value: 15.

If no access request is received within the timeout period, load balancing temporarily breaks the current connection. When the next request arrives, a new connection is established.

You can submit a quota increase request to increase the idle connection timeout period to a maximum of 3600 seconds
parameters.help_zh:
指定连接空闲超时时间。单位：秒。

取值范围：1~600。

默认值：15。

如果在超时时间内一直没有访问请求，负载均衡会暂时中断当前连接，直到一下次请求来临时重新建立新的连接。

用户可以申请提升配额将连接空闲超时时间提升至最大3600秒
parameters.name: idle_timeout

parameters.help_en:
Specifies whether to enable `Gzip` compression to compress specific types of files. Valid values:

true (default): Enabled.
false: Disabled
parameters.help_zh:
是否开启`Gzip`压缩，对特定文件类型进行压缩。取值：

true（默认值）：是。
false：否
parameters.name: gzip_enabled

parameters.help_en:
Specifies whether to enable `HTTP/2`. Valid values:
true (default): Enabled.
false: Disabled.

Only HTTPS listeners support this parameter
parameters.help_zh:
是否开启`HTTP/2`特性。取值：
true（默认值）：是。
false：否。

仅HTTPS监听支持此参数
parameters.name: http2_enabled

parameters.help_en:
The security policy ID. System security policies and custom security policies are supported.

Default value: tls_cipher_policy_1_0 (system security policy).

Only HTTPS listeners support this parameter
parameters.help_zh:
安全策略ID。支持系统安全策略和自定义安全策略。

默认值：tls_cipher_policy_1_0（系统安全策略）。

仅HTTPS监听支持此参数
parameters.name: security_policy_id

parameters.help_en:
Specifies whether to enable mutual authentication. Valid values:

true: Enabled.
false (default): Disabled
parameters.help_zh:
是否开启双向认证。取值：

true：开启。
false（默认值）：不开启
parameters.name: ca_enabled

fields.help_en:
The custom header name. This parameter takes effect only when XForwardedForClientCertClientVerifyEnabled is set to true.

The value must be 1 to 40 characters in length, and can contain lowercase letters a to z, hyphens (-), underscores (_), and digits.

Only HTTPS listeners support this parameter
fields.help_zh:
自定义头名称，只有当XForwardedForClientCertClientVerifyEnabled的值为true的时候，该值才会生效；否则该值不会生效。

取值：1\~40个字符。支持字母a~z、短划线（-）、下划线（_）和数字。

仅HTTPS监听支持此参数
fields.name: xforwarded_for_client_cert_client_verify_alias

fields.help_en:
Specifies whether to use the `X-Forwarded-Clientcert-clientverify` header to retrieve the verification result of the client certificate that accesses the load balancing instance. Valid values:

true: Enabled.
false (default): Disabled.

Only HTTPS listeners support this parameter
fields.help_zh:
是否通过`X-Forwarded-Clientcert-clientverify`头字段获取对访问负载均衡实例客户端证书的校验结果。取值：

true：是。
false（默认值）：否。

仅HTTPS监听支持此参数
fields.name: xforwarded_for_client_cert_client_verify_enabled

fields.help_en:
The custom header name. This parameter takes effect only when XForwardedForClientCertFingerprintEnabled is set to true.

The value must be 1 to 40 characters in length, and can contain lowercase letters a to z, hyphens (-), underscores (_), and digits.

Only HTTPS listeners support this parameter
fields.help_zh:
自定义头名称，只有当XForwardedForClientCertFingerprintEnabled的值为true时生效。

取值：1\~40个字符。支持字母a~z、短划线（-）、下划线（_）和数字。

仅HTTPS监听支持此参数
fields.name: xforwarded_for_client_cert_fingerprint_alias

fields.help_en:
Specifies whether to use the `X-Forwarded-Clientcert-fingerprint` header to retrieve the fingerprint of the client certificate that accesses the load balancing instance. Valid values:

true: Enabled.
false (default): Disabled.

Only HTTPS listeners support this parameter
fields.help_zh:
是否通过`X-Forwarded-Clientcert-fingerprint`头字段获取访问负载均衡实例客户端证书的指纹取值。取值：

true：是。
false（默认值）：否。

仅HTTPS监听支持此参数
fields.name: xforwarded_for_client_cert_fingerprint_enabled

fields.help_en:
The custom header name. This parameter takes effect only when XForwardedForClientCertIssuerDNEnabled is set to true.

The value must be 1 to 40 characters in length, and can contain lowercase letters a to z, hyphens (-), underscores (_), and digits.

Only HTTPS listeners support this parameter
fields.help_zh:
自定义头名称，只有当XForwardedForClientCertIssuerDNEnabled的值为true的时候，此值才会生效。

取值：1\~40个字符。支持字母a~z、短划线（-）、下划线（_）和数字。

仅HTTPS监听支持此参数
fields.name: xforwarded_for_client_cert_issuer_dn_alias

fields.help_en:
Specifies whether to use the `X-Forwarded-Clientcert-issuerdn` header to retrieve the issuer information of the client certificate that accesses the load balancing instance. Valid values:

true: Enabled.
false (default): Disabled.

Only HTTPS listeners support this parameter
fields.help_zh:
是否通过`X-Forwarded-Clientcert-issuerdn`头字段获取访问负载均衡实例客户端证书的发行者信息。取值：

true：是。
false（默认值）：否。

仅HTTPS监听支持此参数
fields.name: xforwarded_for_client_cert_issuer_dn_enabled

fields.help_en:
The custom header name. This parameter takes effect only when XForwardedForClientCertSubjectDNEnabled is set to true.

The value must be 1 to 40 characters in length, and can contain lowercase letters a to z, hyphens (-), underscores (_), and digits.

Only HTTPS listeners support this parameter
fields.help_zh:
自定义头名称，只有当XForwardedForClientCertSubjectDNEnabled的值为true时，此值才会生效。

取值：1\~40个字符。支持字母a~z、短划线（-）、下划线（_）和数字。

仅HTTPS监听支持此参数
fields.name: xforwarded_for_client_cert_subject_dn_alias

fields.help_en:
Specifies whether to use the `X-Forwarded-Clientcert-subjectdn` header to retrieve the owner information of the client certificate that accesses the load balancing instance. Valid values:
true: Enabled.
false (default): Disabled.

Only HTTPS listeners support this parameter
fields.help_zh:
是否通过`X-Forwarded-Clientcert-subjectdn`头字段获取访问负载均衡实例客户端证书的所有者信息。取值：
true：是。
false（默认值）：否。

仅HTTPS监听支持此参数
fields.name: xforwarded_for_client_cert_subject_dn_enabled

fields.help_en:
Specifies whether to allow ALB to look up the real client IP address in the X-Forwarded-For header. Valid values:

true: Enabled.
false (default): Disabled.

HTTP and HTTPS listeners support this parameter
fields.help_zh:
是否允许ALB从X-Forwarded-For头字段中查找真实客户端IP。取值：

true：是。
false（默认值）：否。

HTTP、HTTPS监听支持此参数
fields.name: xforwarded_for_client_source_ips_enabled

fields.help_en:
The trusted proxy IP addresses.

Application Load Balancing (ALB) traverses the `X-Forwarded-For` header from right to left and selects the first IP address that is not in the trusted IP list as the real client IP address. This IP address is used for source IP-based rate limiting
fields.help_zh:
指定可信的代理IP。

应用型负载均衡ALB会从后往前遍历`X-Forwarded-For`，选取第一个不在可信IP列表中的IP作为真实的客户端IP，该IP会被用于源IP限速
fields.name: xforwarded_for_client_source_ips_trusted

fields.help_en:
Specifies whether to use the `X-Forwarded-Client-srcport` header to retrieve the port of the client that accesses the load balancing instance. Valid values:
true: Enabled.
false (default): Disabled.

HTTP and HTTPS listeners support this parameter
fields.help_zh:
是否通过`X-Forwarded-Client-srcport`头字段获取访问负载均衡实例客户端的端口。取值：
true：是。
false（默认值）：否。

HTTP和HTTPS监听支持此参数
fields.name: xforwarded_for_client_src_port_enabled

fields.help_en:
Specifies whether to use the `X-Forwarded-For` header to retrieve the real IP address of the client. Valid values:
true (default): Enabled.
false: Disabled.

If you set this parameter to true, XForwardedForProcessingMode defaults to append and can be changed to remove.
If you set this parameter to false, ALB retains the `X-Forwarded-For` header without additional processing before forwarding the request to the backend server.
HTTP and HTTPS listeners support this parameter
fields.help_zh:
是否通过`X-Forwarded-For`头字段获取来访者真实IP。取值：
true（默认值）：是。
false：否。

配置true，XForwardedForProcessingMode默认取值append，支持修改为remove。
配置false，ALB将请求发送至后端服务之前保留`X-Forwarded-For`头字段，不做额外处理。
HTTP和HTTPS监听支持此参数
fields.name: xforwarded_for_enabled

fields.help_en:
Specifies whether to use the `X-Forwarded-Host` header to retrieve the domain name of the client that accesses the load balancing instance. Valid values:
true: Enabled.
false (default): Disabled.

HTTP, HTTPS, and QUIC listeners support this parameter
fields.help_zh:
是否开启通过`X-Forwarded-Host`头字段获取访问负载均衡实例客户端的域名。取值：
true：是。
false（默认值）：否。

HTTP、HTTPS和QUIC监听支持此参数
fields.name: xforwarded_for_host_enabled

fields.help_en:
The mode for processing the `X-Forwarded-For` header. This parameter takes effect only when XForwardedForEnabled is set to true. Valid values:
append (default): Append.
remove: Remove.

If you set this parameter to append, the last-hop IP address is appended to the `X-Forwarded-For` header before the request is forwarded to the backend server.
If you set this parameter to remove, the `X-Forwarded-For` header is removed before the request is forwarded to the backend server, regardless of whether the request contains the `X-Forwarded-For` header.
HTTP and HTTPS listeners support this parameter
fields.help_zh:
处理`X-Forwarded-For`头字段的模式。只有当XForwardedForEnabled为true时，此值才会生效。取值：
append（默认值）：附加。
remove：删除。

配置append，将请求发送至后端服务之前把最后一跳IP加入`X-Forwarded-For`头字段。
配置remove，请求发送至后端服务之前删除`X-Forwarded-For`标头，无论请求是否携带`X-Forwarded-For`头字段。
HTTP和HTTPS监听支持此参数
fields.name: xforwarded_for_processing_mode

fields.help_en:
Specifies whether to use the `X-Forwarded-Proto` header to retrieve the listener protocol of the load balancing instance. Valid values:
true: Enabled.
false (default): Disabled.

HTTP, HTTPS, and QUIC listeners support this parameter
fields.help_zh:
是否通过`X-Forwarded-Proto`头字段获取负载均衡实例的监听协议。取值：
true：是。
false（默认值）：否。

HTTP、HTTPS和QUIC监听支持此参数
fields.name: xforwarded_for_proto_enabled

fields.help_en:
Specifies whether to use the `SLB-ID` header to retrieve the load balancing instance ID. Valid values:
true: Enabled.
false (default): Disabled.

HTTP, HTTPS, and QUIC listeners support this parameter
fields.help_zh:
是否通过`SLB-ID`头字段获取负载均衡实例ID。取值：
true：是。
false（默认值）：否。

HTTP、HTTPS和QUIC监听支持此参数
fields.name: xforwarded_for_slb_id_enabled

fields.help_en:
Specifies whether to use the `X-Forwarded-Port` header to retrieve the listener port of the load balancing instance. Valid values:
true: Enabled.
false (default): Disabled.

HTTP, HTTPS, and QUIC listeners support this parameter
fields.help_zh:
是否通过`X-Forwarded-Port`头字段获取负载均衡实例的监听端口。取值：
true：是。
false（默认值）：否。

HTTP、HTTPS和QUIC监听支持此参数
fields.name: xforwarded_for_slb_port_enabled

parameters.help_en: The configuration of the XForward field
parameters.name: xforwarded_for_config

fields.help_en:
The ID of the QUIC listener to be associated. This parameter is valid for HTTPS listeners. This parameter is required when QuicUpgradeEnabled is set to true.

The original listener and the associated QUIC listener must belong to the same ALB instance, and the QUIC listener must not have been previously associated
fields.help_zh:
需要关联的QUIC监听ID，HTTPS监听时有效，当QuicUpgradeEnabled为true时该参数必选。

原始监听和关联的QUIC监听必须属于同一个ALB实例，并且此QUIC监听之前没有被关联过
fields.name: quic_listener_id

fields.help_en:
Specifies whether to enable QUIC upgrade. Valid values:
true: Enabled.
false (default): Disabled.

Only HTTPS listeners support this parameter
fields.help_zh:
是否开启QUIC升级。取值：
true：是。
false（默认值）：否。

仅HTTPS监听支持此参数
fields.name: quic_upgrade_enabled

parameters.help_en: The configuration of the associated QUIC listener
parameters.name: quic_config

fields.help_en:
The default certificate ID. Only one default server certificate is supported.

This parameter is required when ListenerProtocol is set to HTTPS or QUIC.
To add more server certificates, call https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/2254830.html to configure additional certificates after the listener is created
fields.help_zh:
默认证书ID，目前仅支持添加 1 个默认服务器证书。

当ListenerProtocol参数取值为HTTPS或QUIC的时候，此参数为必填。
如需更多服务器证书，可在创建监听后调用https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/2254830.html配置扩展证书
fields.name: certificate_id

fields.help_en:
The CA certificate ID.

This parameter is required when CaEnabled is set to true
fields.help_zh:
CA证书ID。

当CaEnabled参数取值为true的时候，此参数为必填
fields.name: certificate_id

parameters.help_en: The list of CA certificates configured for the listener. Only one CA certificate is supported
parameters.help_zh: 监听配置的CA证书列表。目前仅支持添加1个CA证书
parameters.name: ca_certificates

fields.help_en: The ID of the destination server group to which requests are forwarded
fields.help_zh: 转发到的目的服务器组ID
fields.name: server_group_id

fields.help_en: The forwarding destination server group tuples
fields.help_zh: 转发目标服务器元组
fields.name: server_group_tuples

fields.help_en: The configuration of the forwarding action. You can add up to 20 forwarding action configurations
fields.help_zh: 转发动作对应的配置。最多支持添加20个转发动作对应的配置
fields.name: forward_group_config

fields.help_en:
The action type. You can add up to 1 action type.

Valid values: ForwardGroup: forwards requests to multiple server groups
fields.help_zh:
动作类型。最多支持添加1个动作类型。

取值：ForwardGroup，表示转发至多个服务器组
fields.name: type

fields.help_en: The tag key. The tag key can be up to 128 characters in length. It cannot start with aliyun or acs: and cannot contain http:// or https://
fields.help_zh: 标签键。最多支持128个字符，不能以aliyun或acs:开头，不能包含http://或https://
fields.name: key

fields.help_en: The tag value. The tag value can be up to 128 characters in length. It cannot start with aliyun or acs: and cannot contain http:// or https://
fields.help_zh: 标签值。最多支持128个字符，不能以aliyun或acs:开头，不能包含http://或https://
fields.name: value
